ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Deal flow, Deep dive and later stages need Conviction, Round size and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Deal_flow", CASE(StageName, "Sourced", 1, "Screening", 2, "First meeting", 3, "Deep dive", 4, "Partner meeting", 5, "Term sheet", 6, "Due diligence", 7, "Investment committee", 8, "Invested", 9, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Conviction__c)), ISBLANK(Round_size__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Conviction, Round size and Next step date before moving to Deep dive.
